did worse when the test was repeated
were younger than the students with laptops

the lectures

students who write by hand
supporters of typing

exercises.passage:
Selin: I've been invited to give a short talk at a conference next month, but I'm really nervous about speaking in front of a crowd.
Mark: ----
Selin: That's a good idea. My sister could listen to me and tell me which parts are unclear.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I gave a talk at the same conference last year, and nobody came to listen.
Why don't you practise it a few times in front of a friend or family member first?
Conferences are usually held in large hotels in the city centre.
You should refuse the invitation, since you have never spoken in public before.
I'm sure the organisers will pay for your travel and hotel room.
exercises.explanation: Selin ‘iyi fikir’ diyerek kız kardeşinin onu dinleyebileceğini söylüyor; bu, önce bir arkadaş ya da aile üyesinin önünde prova etme önerisine verilen yanıttır: ‘Why don't you practise it a few times in front of a friend or family member first?’ ‘nobody’ içeren cevap bir öneri değildir; otellerle (‘hotels’) ve masraflarla (‘organisers’) ilgili cevaplar kaygıya çözüm sunmaz; daveti reddetme (‘refuse’) önerisi ise kız kardeşine prova yapma fikriyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage:

Shop assistant: I'm sorry to hear that. ----

Shop assistant: Thank you. Would you like a new jacket or your money back?
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Would you like to try on a different colour?
Did you pay for it in cash?

Elif: Yes, I read about it. They say repairing it would cost too much.
Ahmet: ----
Elif: I agree. Maybe we should sign the petition that some of our neighbours have started.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Good news! I've never liked swimming anyway.
Where exactly is that swimming pool?
Repairs like that usually take about three months.
That's a pity. Hundreds of children learn to swim there every summer.
I've already bought a ticket for tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: Elif ‘katılıyorum’ deyip havuzu kurtarmak için imza vermeyi öneriyor; demek ki Ahmet kapanmaya üzülmüştür: ‘That's a pity. Hundreds of children learn to swim there every summer.’ ‘Good news’ imza kampanyasıyla çelişir; ‘Where’ ile başlayan soru Ahmet’in kendi söylediği ‘evimizin yakınındaki’ bilgisine terstir ve ‘I agree’ ile yanıtlanamaz; onarım süresi (‘months’) ve bilet (‘ticket’) ise konuya bağlanmaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The concert was so crowded that we could hardly see the stage.
options: Although the concert was crowded, we had a clear view of the stage.
We could not go to the concert because there were too many people.
There were so many people at the concert that it was very difficult for us to see the stage.
The stage was so small that hardly anyone came to the concert.
Few people came to the concert, so we could see the stage easily.
exercises.explanation: ‘so crowded that we could hardly see’ kalabalık yüzünden sahneyi neredeyse göremediklerini anlatır: ‘There were so many people at the concert that it was very difficult for us to see the stage.’ ‘clear view’ ve ‘easily’ içeren cümleler anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘could not go’ konsere hiç gidemediklerini söyler; ‘small’ içeren cümle ise nedeni sahnenin küçüklüğüne bağlar.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

If I had known about the heavy traffic, I would have left home earlier.
options: I knew about the heavy traffic, so I left home earlier.
I left home early, but I was still caught in the heavy traffic.
If there is heavy traffic tomorrow, I will leave home earlier.
I didn't leave home earlier because I didn't know about the heavy traffic.
Although I didn't know about the traffic, I left home earlier than usual.
exercises.explanation: Üçüncü tip koşul geçmişteki gerçeğin tersini anlatır: trafiği bilmiyordu, bu yüzden erken çıkmadı: ‘I didn't leave home earlier because I didn't know about the heavy traffic.’ ‘knew’ içeren cümle bildiğini söyler; ‘caught’ içeren cümle erken çıktığını söyler; ‘tomorrow’ cümleyi geleceğe taşır; ‘usual’ içeren cümle de erken çıktığını iddia eder.

exercises.passage: Chocolate is made from the seeds of the cacao tree, which originally grew in Central and South America. The Maya and Aztec peoples used these seeds to prepare a bitter drink, which was often mixed with water, chilli and other spices. ---- When the Spanish brought the seeds to Europe in the sixteenth century, sugar was added to make the drink sweeter, and it soon became popular among rich families.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Today, Switzerland is famous for producing high-quality chocolate bars.
Eating too much chocolate can be harmful to dogs and cats.
The seeds were so valuable to the Aztecs that they were even used as money.
Chilli peppers are easy to grow in warm and sunny climates.
Many people prefer dark chocolate because it contains less sugar.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce Azteklerin tohumları nasıl kullandığı, sonra tohumların Avrupa’ya gelişi anlatılır; tohumların değerini anlatan ‘The seeds were so valuable to the Aztecs that they were even used as money.’ bu tarihsel akışı sürdürür. ‘Switzerland’ ve ‘dark chocolate’ içeren cümleler günümüze atlar; köpekler (‘dogs’) ve biber yetiştirme (‘peppers’) ise konudan kopar.

exercises.passage: Many adults believe that it is too late for them to learn a musical instrument, because they think only children can develop this skill. ---- In one study, people aged between sixty and eighty-five who took piano lessons for six months improved not only their playing but also their memory and attention. The researchers concluded that, with regular practice, people of any age can make real progress.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: As a result, music schools for children have become very expensive.
However, recent research suggests that this belief is not entirely correct.
The piano was invented in Italy at the beginning of the eighteenth century.
Similarly, children who learn music often do better at mathematics.
For this reason, most adults stop practising after only a few weeks.
exercises.explanation: İlk cümle bir inancı anlatır, sonraki cümleler bu inancı çürüten bir araştırmayı verir; aradaki geçişi ‘However, recent research suggests that this belief is not entirely correct.’ sağlar. ‘expensive’ ve ‘invented’ içeren cümleler konudan sapar; ‘Similarly’ ile başlayan cümle çocuklara döner ve araştırmaya bağlanmaz; ‘For this reason’ ile başlayan cümle ise paragrafın vardığı sonuçla çelişir.

exercises.passage: (I) The Great Wall of China was not built at one time but over many centuries by different ruling families. (II) Most of the parts that tourists visit today were built during the Ming period, between the fourteenth and seventeenth centuries. (III) Workers used whatever materials were available nearby, such as earth, stone, wood and, later, bricks. (IV) Chinese food, especially rice and noodles, has become popular in restaurants all over the world. (V) Many of these workers died because of the hard conditions, the cold weather and the lack of food.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V

exercises.passage: (I) Chess is believed to have started in India around the sixth century. (II) From there, it spread to Persia and later reached Europe through trade and travel. (V) Card games, on the other hand, are usually based on luck rather than on skill.

options: I

exercises.passage: (I) Emperor penguins live in Antarctica, one of the coldest places on Earth. (II) Unlike most birds, the female lays a single egg in the middle of winter and then goes to the sea to feed. (III) Polar bears, which also live in very cold regions, are excellent swimmers and can travel long distances in water. (IV) During this time, the male keeps the egg warm on his feet for about two months without eating. (V) When the female returns, she feeds the newly born chick with food that she has stored in her stomach.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf imparator penguenlerinin yumurta ve yavru bakımını anlatır. ‘III’ numaralı cümle kutup ayılarına geçer; ayrıca (IV) numaralı cümledeki ‘During this time’ dişinin denize gittiği süreyi, yani (II) numaralı cümleyi gösterir. ‘I’ yaşam yerini, ‘II’ yumurtlamayı, ‘IV’ erkeğin görevini, ‘V’ dişinin dönüşünü anlatır.

exercises.passage: (I) Paper was first made in China about two thousand years ago from tree bark, old cloth and plant fibres. (V) It was only when machines were introduced in the nineteenth century that paper became cheap enough for everyone.

options: I

exercises.explanation: Paragraf kâğıdın Çin’de bulunuşundan makinelerle ucuzlamasına kadar tarihini anlatır. ‘II’ numaralı cümle bugünkü ofislere ve ormanları korumaya geçerek bu akışı bozar; (III) numaralı cümledeki ‘the technique’ doğrudan (I) numaralı cümledeki üretime bağlanır. ‘I’, ‘III’, ‘IV’ ve ‘V’ birbirini zaman sırasıyla izler.
